about_the_game:
Dive into a captivating puzzle adventure with Twin Flames! Guide Savitri and Satyavan, two destined souls, through a vibrant hex-grid world. In their 27th attempt to unite as Twin Flames, your strategic choices shape their fate. Can you help them overcome obstacles and forge an unbreakable bond?

What to Expect in the Demo:

  • 12 Levels of Gameplay: Master turn-based puzzles across 12 unique levels on a dynamic hex-grid.

  • Strategic Depth: Plan every move, clear paths, and solve intricate challenges as a duo.

  • Emotional Connection: Feel the pull of Savitri and Satyavan’s journey toward unity.

  • Vivid Low Poly Art: Explore a breathtaking, minimalist world that brings the story to life.

  • Co-op Teaser: Try local co-op mode and test your synergy with a friend.

Join the Twin Flames’ quest in this demo and guide them through 12 levels of love, strategy, and puzzles. Download now and start their journey!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R7 260x
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 or AMD Radeon R7 260x
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Team up in TWIN FLAMES, a co-op puzzle adventure! Guide Savitri & Satyavan through hex-grid challenges in a mystical low-poly world. Solve puzzles, forge their bond, and uncover their 27th attempt at destiny.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
